text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Organisation of African Unity, condemning the recent coup in Sierra Leone, has all but asked for African intervention to assist the people of that country to restore constitutional order.

- Palestinian Foreign Affairs Minister Farouk Kaddumi on Tuesday said African governments should exert pressure on Israel in an attempt to persuade the Middle East country to respect a peace accord signed with Palestine in 1991.
- Zimbabwe's secretary for health Paulinus Sikosana says the ministry has earmarked more than Z$800 million to buy equipment for hospitals in the next three years.
